definition: available at a lower price than usual
example: Winter boots are on sale for 40 percent off this week only.

definition: not available in a store because all have been sold
example: The blender I wanted was out of stock, so the store ordered one for me.

definition: a store's rules about taking back items customers have bought
example: Check the return policy before buying electronics; some stores only allow 15 days.

definition: to return something you bought and get a different item instead
example: Can I exchange these shoes for a larger size?

definition: something bought for less than its usual price; a good deal
example: At $50, this used bike was a real bargain.

definition: an amount taken off the usual price
example: Students get a 10 percent discount if they show their student card.

definition: to sell an item at the same lower price a competitor offers
vi: khớp giá (bán bằng giá thấp hơn của đối thủ)
example: The store agreed to price match the TV after I showed them the online ad.

definition: to compare prices at different stores before buying
vi: so sánh giá ở nhiều nơi trước khi mua
example: It pays to shop around for car insurance and internet plans.
collocations: shop around for the best price

definition: not expensive; suitable for people with limited money
vi: phù hợp túi tiền, giá rẻ
example: We found a budget-friendly sofa that still looks stylish.

definition: costing more than it is worth
vi: đắt quá mức, giá bị đội lên
example: Food at the airport is overpriced, so I always bring my own snacks.

definition: good enough to justify the price
example: The jacket was expensive, but it was worth the money because it lasted ten winters.

definition: made by a well-known company
example: Store brands are often just as good as brand-name products but cost less.

definition: previously owned and used by someone else
vi: đồ cũ, đã qua sử dụng
example: Buying second-hand furniture is cheaper and better for the environment.

definition: to buy something through a website or app
example: I usually order online and pick up the groceries at the store on my way home.
collocations: order online and pick up in store

definition: the money charged for bringing goods to your home
example: The delivery fee is waived for orders over $75.

definition: delivery with no extra charge
example: The website offers free shipping on all orders during the holiday season.

definition: ordered but not yet available, so it will be sent later
vi: (hàng) đang chờ nhập, đặt trước chưa có hàng
example: Your desk is backordered and should ship in about three weeks.

definition: a scheme that rewards regular customers with points or discounts
vi: chương trình khách hàng thân thiết
example: With the grocery store's loyalty program, I earn points I can use for free food.

definition: buying things suddenly without planning
vi: mua sắm bốc đồng, theo cảm hứng
example: Making a shopping list helps me avoid impulse buying at the supermarket.

definition: a piece of paper or email showing what you bought and paid
example: Keep the receipt in case you need to return the gift.

definition: the place in a store where you pay for your items
example: The line at the checkout was so long that I used the self-serve machines.

definition: tax added to the price of goods, such as GST and PST in BC
example: The price on the tag doesn't include sales tax, so expect to pay about 12 percent more.

definition: a sale with very low prices to get rid of old stock
vi: đợt bán xả hàng, thanh lý
example: I bought patio furniture at a clearance sale at the end of September.

definition: able to last a long time without breaking
example: These hiking boots are more expensive, but they're far more durable.

definition: very good; made to a high standard
example: The farmers' market sells high-quality local produce at fair prices.
